generated_text:

First-order effects: new procurement standards, maintenance training, cartridge tracking, and public demonstration sites.

Third-order effects: local energy literacy increases, but catalyst maintenance may become a new technical gatekeeping role.

Priority implications: public inspection labels and failure reports are strong candidates for later speculative artifacts.
